description: California Consumer Privacy Act — requirements for businesses regarding collection, use, disclosure, and consumer rights for personal information of California residents.

obligations.title: Right to Know and Access
obligations.description: Businesses must provide consumers access to the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected, the purposes of collection, and third parties with whom it is shared.

obligations.title: Right to Delete
obligations.description: Consumers can request deletion of personal information held by a business, subject to exceptions for security, legal compliance, or internal uses aligned with consumer consent.

obligations.title: Right to Correct Inaccurate Information
obligations.description: Consumers have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal information maintained by a business.

obligations.title: Right to Opt-Out of Sale or Sharing
obligations.description: Businesses must provide a clear opt-out mechanism for consumers to stop the sale or sharing of their personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising.

obligations.title: Service Provider Contract Requirements
obligations.description: Contracts with service providers must restrict use of personal information to the business purpose, prohibit unauthorized disclosure, and require confidentiality obligations.

obligations.title: Data Breach Notification
obligations.description: Businesses must notify affected California residents in the most expedient time possible — and no later than 60 days — when unencrypted personal information is breached.

obligations.title: Privacy Notice at Collection
obligations.description: At or before collection of personal information businesses must disclose what categories are collected, the purposes of collection, and consumer rights.

obligations.title: Non-Discrimination for Exercising Rights
obligations.description: Businesses cannot discriminate against consumers for exercising CCPA rights — including denying goods, charging different prices, or providing lower quality service.

obligations.title: Sensitive Personal Information Restrictions
obligations.description: Extra protections apply to sensitive categories including SSN, financial data, health information, biometric data, and precise geolocation. Must offer opt-out of use.
